briefing.headline: Two genuinely fresh remote/NYC arrivals landed today — and the Boston list has gone stale enough to either apply or delete.
briefing.focus: Spend today's 20 min on the fintech-domain and East-Coast/remote roles, not on more Seattle Amazon reqs you've skipped eight times. Anthropic's Enterprise Integrated Campaign Manager (posted 8/14, NYC option) and Stripe's Commerce Experiences GTM PMM are the two where your ABM + banking/fintech background is a genuine differentiator, not a keyword match. Then fire off Webflow's Demand Gen Associate and Amazon's Brand Owner Growth Marketing Manager — both brand-new, both under-scored by the keyword filter, both at the right level. Note: 20+ ZoomInfo/recruiter/PERM-notice listings polluted today's feed; I've flagged them for pruning.

The only Boston B2B marketing role at your level, full stop — but 8 surfaces with no action means apply today or tell me to drop CarGurus.

Clean BA II req (not a PERM notice), zero missing keywords, only surfaced once — the best of Amazon's analyst-lane openings.
Core-product PMM at Anthropic posted 8/14; competitive and consumer-adjacent, so treat it as a reach, not a base case.
NYC growth marketing at a large, sponsorship-heavy public company — but product-led developer growth is a different motion than enterprise ABM.
Still the cleanest remote-US marketing-analyst title anywhere on this list; eight pushes with no move says you're either applying or you're not.
GTM strategy and planning at a strong late-stage company with zero keyword gaps — more revenue ops than marketing, so a lane-adjacent bet.
Pure ABM at AWS and a perfect skill match, but seven prior pushes plus Arlington relocation says you've already decided.
Eloqua/HubSpot segmentation and email architecture is hands-on your toolset; narrower scope than your last role, though.
Remote-US at a large public company, but global events is a logistics-heavy pivot away from positioning and funnel work.
Associate-level marketing automation at a public company — right seniority and right stack, modest brand and NYC-only.
Remote GTM analytics that fits your MBA, but 'Manager' at Lattice's size means owning it solo, and seven pushes suggest you've passed.

Boston-based analyst role, which is scarce — but PE-owned consumer hardware is the weakest sponsorship profile in your Boston set.
Fresh, US-remote, and Databricks sponsors aggressively; partner events is a real function but a sideways move from PMM.
Associate-level is correctly pitched at your non-senior lane and Datadog sponsors, but field events is execution-heavy and this is push five.
Posted today at a large established sponsor; campaign manager is the right altitude even if AEC software is unfamiliar ground.
Fit 100 is nonsense — this is health-insurance sales operations, likely licensing-adjacent, and it's been in front of you six times.
